scenarios: Every available supported public Effect default is compiled and invoked by native held block-use input. Obsolete doors/trapdoors/gates and native event2005 are rejected before publication.

Typed payload and emission checks observe six native directions, axes, opaque RGB, bone-meal quantities, booleans, native integer defaults, event anchors, radius filtering and offsets. Dragon breath audible true/false produces native data1/0 consistently.

The native client configuration song registry is captured independently; canonical public keys are compared with that order. Every available music disc, direct native-song selection and separate record-stop event1011 are observed in actual effect packets.

Native custom totem use preserves material/model metadata, health, count and real offhand totems; display-only copies have death_protection and native equipment/status/restore order. Preexisting positive/removal component patches and escaped opaque data survive preparation.

Pre-cancelled native use, delayed source replacement and reload cancel the corresponding status/spoof. Public API guard/reentry/slot-change cases retain current server equipment and balanced client restoration.
Custom/vanilla command invocation, item/quiet completion, unknown API item rejection and strict candidate failure preserve the live registry.

primary_native_contracts.native_smoke_directions: 0 DOWN,1 UP,2 NORTH,3 SOUTH,4 WEST,5 EAST; legacy diagonal/SELF projections are rejected
primary_native_contracts.dragon_breath: Event2006 always emits200 particles; only data1 plays its sound. BlocksAdder audible false/true maps to0/1.
primary_native_contracts.totem_selection: Entity status35 selects the first hand item containing death_protection. Confirmed in official1.21.11/26.1.2/26.2 client code;26.3 uses packet evidence and retains user rendered acceptance.

development_findings: Spigot and Paper expose different public enum aliases/data classes, including record Material/JukeboxSong and block Material/BlockData. Cached public field aliases and typed adapters preserve common content settings.

The old material-based record converter produces an item ID, contrary to the native song-ID contract. An early public-registry iteration fallback also failed actual captured song IDs. Final legacy fallback uses bounded canonical keys validated against client configuration registry data; typed public song APIs take precedence.
Paper rejects alpha in effect colors; effect payloads now normalize to RGB while particle alpha support stays separate.
Paper dragon-breath Boolean means silence and encodes -1/1. The independent audible setting uses the public integer overload with explicit native sound semantics.
Static native-client checks found obsolete event2005 and downward folding of diagonal/SELF smoke. Those ambiguous legacy modes are rejected rather than advertised as functioning effects.

Totem activation needs death_protection on a same-material display copy. Bounds precede public decoding, unchanged codec round trips detect loss, and nested finally blocks preserve authoritative restoration/reentry/overlay cleanup.
fixture_corrections: A stale disposable effect-proof bundle containing diagonal smoke prevented plugin enable before the probe could replace it. The private runner now writes one valid bootstrap fixture before startup; the excluded timeout supplied no effect evidence.

Native song registry capture uses configuration packets plus bounded anonymous-NBT skipping on776/777. Private expected song IDs follow the actual received registry rather than an assumed item/enum order.
A Paper field alias changes VILLAGER_PLANT_GROW into BEE_GROWTH. Portable crop-quantity cases now use the real BONE_MEAL_USE capability.

separate_controls.interpretation: ProtocolLib alone with zero receiving movement listeners passes. Earlier full root/model-adapter integration on Paper26.3 disconnected before input; this narrows the issue to that listener/integration path and does not prove a provider-alone defect.

rea.result: Host timed out after450seconds; no new Evidence returned. The unchanged call was not repeated. Retained archive facts and clearly identified ordinary public-SDK/client static inspection informed the independent reconstruction.

method: Java21 bytecode/1.21.11 endpoint runtimes and Java25 on26.x; isolated loopback servers and native protocols774/775/776/777. No graphical Minecraft client, launcher, screenshot automation or version translator.

Accepted targeted runs use one frozen core/probe artifact. Public native API/equipment callbacks, protocol observations and headless metadata assertions are distinct scopes. Earlier development runs are excluded from totals.

Production uses public Bukkit APIs and the existing optional public ProtocolLib adapter; no original JAR execution, reference implementation/asset/configuration copying, production NMS or server implementation reflection is introduced.
limitations: Totals include repeated native/API/data and headless assertions, not that many distinct user interactions or complete original-plugin parity.

Core new actions cover nine builds without ProtocolLib. Particle regressions cover four endpoints; optional callback/mask integration covers Spigot/Paper1.21.11 and Paper26.2 with the recorded official snapshot.

Paper26.3 movement disconnect with the full ProtocolLib/model-input listener path remains unresolved. A no-BlocksAdder/no-listener control passes, so provider-alone incompatibility is not established; broader camera/emote acceptance remains open.
Canonical built-in native song IDs are verified for the tested registry data. Custom datapack registration/reconfiguration and alternate server implementations need their own mapping evidence.
Third-party packet filters can suppress/replace cosmetic packets. No delivery receipt or global effect rate limiter is provided; native integer effect data retains its platform-specific meaning.

Rendered activation/model/particle appearance and perceived audio remain user verification. The26.3 client implementation was not statically inspected; native packet tests do not replace rendered acceptance.
Temporary tools/servers remain ignored locally after earlier automatic approval review rejected cleanup. No testing source, original artifact/asset or foreign configuration is committed or bundled.
